item.title: Sumitomo Forestry to Acquire Tri Pointe Homes in $4.5 Billion Deal
item.description: As part of its efforts to expand in the U.S. market, Japanese homebuilder Sumitomo Forestry Co., Ltd. announced plans to acquire Tri Pointe Homes, Inc. for $4.5 billion in cash. Officials said the deal will pay stockholders $47 per share, representing a 29% premium over Tri Pointe’s closing price on Friday of $36.57.
